understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate each grid-based level to step onto and complete all goal cells. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece’s shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required values; after completing all goals in the current level, you advance to the next level. Managing stamina and lives is part of successfully finishing all levels without reaching GAME_OVER.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina. When stamina reaches 0, you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum; losing all lives ends the game. Walls block movement; the state provides blocked_directions and attempting a blocked direction wastes a turn/stamina without moving, so you must route around obstacles. Modifier tiles change the carried piece when stepped on: shape modifiers cycle shape IDs 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange (wrapping), and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise (0°→90°→180°→270°→0°). To complete a goal, you plan a path that hits the necessary modifiers to reach the required attributes, then step onto the goal tile while matched.
